name: NMR molecular structure elucidation
description: elucidate(h_spectrum, c_spectrum, metadata, k) -> list of one to k distinct molecular SMILES. Metadata may include formula and target-free candidate_smiles. Score exact RDKit-canonical molecular graph recovery in top five; top1 is diagnostic. Enforce valid connected graph and supplied formula. Stereochemistry is ignored only when source labels do not resolve it. Simulated and experimental source subsets must remain separate.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Infer molecular connectivity from routine one-dimensional NMR spectra.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Chemical structure identification is needed to characterize synthesized or isolated compounds.

papers.title: Accurate and Efficient Structure Elucidation from Routine One-Dimensional NMR Spectra Using Multitask Machine Learning
papers.primary_goal: Recover chemical structures from one-dimensional proton and carbon NMR measurements.
papers.task_relation: The local task returns ranked molecular graphs from corresponding spectral inputs, separating simulated and experimental subsets. Restricted candidate libraries and top-five graph matching do not establish full stereochemical elucidation or general identification of unknown compounds.
